about: Every day of 2026-2040 on which the engine differs from the SSPX Ordo (ordo.fsspx.org, congregation empty), on celebration or commemorations, as reviewed 2026-11-09. Development-time cross-check only; the Ordo data is not in this repository. Run with ORDO_DIR set to a folder of ordo-en-<year>.json files to re-check.

groups.why: The Ordo keeps a bare feria on early-January Saturdays. The FSSP 2026 calendar has Our Lady on Saturday (3 and 10 January).
The Ordo commemorates the Advent feria on the Vigil of Christmas, which admits no commemoration. The FSSP 2026 calendar prints none.
The Ordo omits the commemoration of the Christmas octave on 26-28 December. The FSSP 2026 calendar prints it.
The Ordo keeps the Saturday after the Ascension as a feria; it is a 4th class feria, so Our Lady on Saturday applies. Missale Meum agrees with the engine.
